yield — What the holdings earn and how they move with interest rates, as of a date (default today). A rate belongs to a currency: an aggregate row is one entity in one currency, plus a value-weighted total (quality mixed). Views: global (per currency and a total, with duration and dv01: the whole portfolio's rate risk); sources, portfolios, accounts; positions (per holding; columns=+coupon,maturity_date,price on request); securities (each security, direct and through funds: a bond's coupon, maturity, price, implied yield and rating (columns=+rating), a stock's earnings yield, P/E, dividend yield, payout and growth); funds (each fund: what its lines imply, its page's yields and duration, as of when); cash (each balance, term deposit and money-market fund with rate, benchmark and gap, worst paid first); curve (DV01 per currency and tenor: 3M, 1Y, 5Y, 10Y, 30Y); coverage (what the figures rest on, what is missing, where each dividend's record day comes from). income_yield: the next twelve months' projected income over value; implied_yield: what the price implies; dv01: the value's fall per basis point. Read quality. Example: {view: "cash"}.

Parameters (all optional):
  view         global | sources | portfolios | accounts | positions | securities | funds | cash | curve | coverage. Which rows to return (default global).
  as_of        As-of date. Default today.
  period       monthly | quarterly | annual. global, sources, portfolios, accounts and curve: a series at the end of each period of from/to (default: the last twelve months).
  from         With period: the series' start (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday, last month, last year).
  to           With period: the series' end, same forms. Default today.
  converted    global, sources, portfolios and accounts: one row per entity in the output currency (default false).
  symbol       positions, funds and cash: keep only rows whose symbol contains this text.
  currency     Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.
  filter       Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].
  search       Keep rows with this text in any cell.
  columns      "default", "all", names, or "+add,-remove"; describe(topic=<tool>) lists them.
  sort         Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.
  max_chars    Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.
  limit        Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).
  offset       Rows to skip (default 0).
  format       table | csv | json. Result format (default table).

Columns (* = shown by default; columns=all shows every one):
  global: currency*, value_USD*, income_yield_pct*, stated_pct, current_yield_pct, implied_yield_pct*, implied_yield_annual_pct, realized_yield_pct*, earnings_yield_pct, dividend_yield_pct, benchmark_pct, gap_pct, duration*, convexity, dv01_USD*, income_12m_USD, income_100bp_USD, maturity, quality*
  sources: silver_source*, currency*, value_USD*, income_yield_pct*, stated_pct, current_yield_pct, implied_yield_pct*, implied_yield_annual_pct, realized_yield_pct*, earnings_yield_pct, dividend_yield_pct, benchmark_pct, gap_pct, duration*, convexity, dv01_USD*, income_12m_USD, income_100bp_USD, maturity, quality*
  portfolios: silver_source*, portfolio*, portfolio_id, currency*, value_USD*, income_yield_pct*, stated_pct, current_yield_pct, implied_yield_pct*, implied_yield_annual_pct, realized_yield_pct*, earnings_yield_pct, dividend_yield_pct, benchmark_pct, gap_pct, duration*, convexity, dv01_USD*, income_12m_USD, income_100bp_USD, maturity, quality*
  accounts: silver_source*, account*, account_id, account_kind, tax_wrapper*, account_nickname, currency*, value_USD*, income_yield_pct*, stated_pct, current_yield_pct, implied_yield_pct*, implied_yield_annual_pct, realized_yield_pct*, earnings_yield_pct, dividend_yield_pct, benchmark_pct, gap_pct, duration*, convexity, dv01_USD*, income_12m_USD, income_100bp_USD, maturity, quality*
  positions: silver_source*, account*, account_id, tax_wrapper, position_key, symbol*, name, asset_class, vehicle, kind*, currency*, value_USD*, income_yield_pct*, stated_pct, current_yield_pct, implied_yield_pct*, implied_yield_annual_pct, realized_yield_pct*, earnings_yield_pct, dividend_yield_pct, benchmark_pct, gap_pct, duration*, convexity, dv01_USD*, income_12m_USD, income_100bp_USD, maturity, coupon_pct, maturity_date, price, coupon_kind, rating, spread_pct, quality*
  securities: security*, name*, ticker, asset_class*, sector, currency, value_USD*, direct_value_USD, via_funds_value_USD, funds, share_pct*, coupon_pct*, maturity_date*, coupon_kind, price, implied_yield_pct*, duration, rating, earnings_yield_pct*, pe, dividend_yield_pct*, payout_pct, dividend_growth_pct, earnings_growth_pct, coverage, quality*
  funds: fund*, name*, symbol, kind*, currency*, value_USD*, implied_yield_pct*, lines_yield_pct, lines_duration, lines_maturity, lines_as_of, lines_covered_pct, floating_pct, in_default_pct, paid_in_kind_pct, yield_to_maturity_pct, duration*, maturity, distribution_yield_pct*, sec_yield_pct*, seven_day_yield_pct, trailing_yield_pct, dv01_USD*, risk_as_of, as_of*, source*, quality*
  cash: silver_source*, account*, account_id, tax_wrapper, kind*, symbol, currency*, value_USD*, rate_pct*, tiers, tier_up_to, valid_from*, term_end*, realized_yield_pct*, benchmark_pct*, gap_pct*, income_12m_USD, income_100bp_USD, quality*
  curve: currency*, tenor*, dv01_USD*, dv100_USD*, funds_USD*, bonds_USD*, cash_USD*, liabilities_USD*
  coverage: section*, reason*, value_USD*, share_pct*, holdings*, payments*, silver_source*, instrument*, account, name*

Filters each view takes (a filter the view lacks moves the call to the first finer view that has it):
  global: none
  sources: none
  portfolios: none
  accounts: none
  positions: symbol
  securities: none
  funds: symbol
  cash: symbol
  curve: none
  coverage: none

A rate belongs to a currency: an aggregate row is one entity in one currency, and the total row weighs the currencies by value (quality mixed); converted gives one row per entity. dv01 is the value lost for a rise of one basis point; a liability's is negative and nets. The quality column says what each figure rests on (describe topic=quality); view=coverage lists what is missing, and counts where the dividends' record days come from: the dividend calendar, an ex day, the issuer's learned gap, the market's lag, or none.
Example: {view: "curve", currency: "CHF"}.

This endpoint redacts amounts, quantities, account numbers and the names taken off statements (merchants, payers, narratives), and shows a name a person typed about an account as a pseudonym such as manual-1, or as its account number, redacted; source ids, other account names, holdings and their names, categories and shares stay visible.
